topic.title: Efficient and Temporally Consistent Video Generation
topic.overview: Video generation must maintain motion, identity, and scene geometry while controlling the cost of processing many frames. These papers study diffusion acceleration, history conditioning, frame interpolation, super-resolution, and streaming world models. Memory design is central because earlier frames can contain information needed to prevent long-horizon drift.
topic.whyItMatters: High-quality short clips do not establish that a model can sustain a coherent interactive scene. Practical systems need efficient inference and selective retention of context without accumulating visual errors or losing important spatial relationships.
topic.evolution: Earlier representatives address video time-series and rendering, followed by hierarchical future prediction. Recent work emphasizes one-step diffusion, dynamic token reduction, and history-guided generation. The 2026 examples combine persistent context, importance-aware cache compression, and memory-aware distillation to support longer videos and interactive control.
openQuestions: Which past frames must remain accessible to preserve geometry after revisiting a scene?
Can speedup methods retain rare but important motion details over long rollouts?

papers.title: MiniMax-Remover: Taming Bad Noise Helps Video Object Removal

papers.title: One-Step Diffusion for Detail-Rich and Temporally Consistent Video Super-Resolution

papers.title: Physics-Driven Spatiotemporal Modeling for AI-Generated Video Detection

papers.title: PMQ-VE: Progressive Multi-Frame Quantization for Video Enhancement
papers.tldr: PMQ-VE combines frame-aware quantization search with progressive multi-teacher training to improve low-bit video enhancement quality.

papers.title: QBasicVSR: Temporal Awareness Adaptation Quantization for Video Super-Resolution
papers.tldr: QBasicVSR adapts quantization to video’s temporal behavior to improve the efficiency and quality of low-precision video super-resolution.

papers.title: ROSE: Remove Objects with Side Effects in Videos

papers.title: SAM2Flow: Interactive Optical Flow Estimation with Dual Memory for in vivo Microcirculation Analysis

papers.title: Self Forcing: Bridging the Train-Test Gap in Autoregressive Video Diffusion

papers.title: Smooth Regularization for Efficient Video Recognition

papers.title: StateSpaceDiffuser: Bringing Long Context to Diffusion World Models
